projects.title: Secure CipherStegno Tool
projects.description: A Python GUI desktop security toolkit integrating cryptography and steganography — major academic dissertation project. Implements AES-256, RSA-2048, ChaCha20, and classical ciphers alongside image, audio, and video LSB steganography.
features: Image, audio, and video LSB steganography
